description: Apply to a job. Only works on keys that already hold apply credits; spends 1 credit. Jobs with an employer contact are submitted into our curate queue (returns an applicationId); external-ATS jobs return the apply URL for the agent to open and finish.

candidate_email.description: Applicant contact email the employer can reply to.

id.description: Job id to apply to, e.g. `job_8f2a1c`.

name: apply_to_job
